what_this_is: The accepted `pid_publish_xml --diff-against` differences, recorded one item at a time. This file is data, not a suppression list: the gate keeps exiting 1 on the figures below. It exists so a reviewer, or a test, can classify every line a run prints as registered, disappeared, or unregistered without reading any prose. Nothing here widens a gate: an unregistered difference still exits 1, and a registered difference that stops being printed is itself a finding.

states.registered: The baseline lists this exact line for this figure, and the run printed it.
states.disappeared: The baseline lists this exact line, and the run did not print it. A disappeared line is a finding: the figure changed under the baseline.
states.unregistered: The run printed a line this baseline does not list. Always a finding. There is no count-based allowance: a figure whose category total merely matches is not thereby accepted.

how_to_verify.1: Run the command recorded in the figure entry and read stdout.
how_to_verify.2: Split stdout into difference lines by the prefixes in difference_line_kinds. Lines that start with `meta `, `reference-only:`, `excused `, or the localized pairing note are accounting, not differences.
how_to_verify.3: For each printed line, look for a byte-identical `line` under the figure. Found -> registered. Not found -> unregistered.
how_to_verify.4: For each `line` under the figure, check it was printed. Not printed -> disappeared.
how_to_verify.5: The figure passes only when the unregistered set and the disappeared set are both empty.

not_enumerated_here: Attribute classes the gate excuses wholesale live in src/publish/diff_exclusions.rs (EXCLUDED_ATTRIBUTE_CLASSES) and are printed as `excused ...` lines. This baseline does not restate them.

The FluidSystem allowances live in src/publish/diff.rs as FLUID_SYSTEM_REFERENCE_EMPTY_ALLOWANCES, one bound per reference DocUID. whole_package.registered_exceptions points at it rather than restating a second bound.
`reference-only:` and `excused ...` lines are accounting, not differences, and are not listed here.

revision_mismatch_figures.what: Four 验收数据 drawings whose `.pid` and the whole-package Export.dmp are different revisions: the drawing's own DocUID has no T_DRAWING row in the dump (0 UTF-16BE occurrences of it in the dump's 74,489,856 bytes), so the dump carries none of that sheet's ports, connectivity, compositions or pipelines. An `--oracle-exp` run over such a pair used to exit 0 having published the `.pid` alone; it now refuses with exit 2 and writes nothing. These are recorded because the pairing is wrong, not because a gate is waived: nothing here makes such a run pass.
